description: A PHP script for rendering and printing test cases within the TestLink test management system. It includes initialization, rendering HTML headers, and generating printable test case content, along with configuration and setup functions.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments for test case ID, version, project ID, and output format.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Creates and initializes a GUI object with display settings based on the passed arguments and test node info.
